title: 会议记录怎样写成可以执行的行动项
topic: 会议记录怎样写成可以执行的行动项

source.title: Writing Meeting Notes for Action - Dropbox
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Dropbox 公开资料。
paragraphs: Ask any athlete and they’ll tell you: there’s no substitute for more reps. By proactively volunteering to lead notetaking in your next meeting, you inject focus into the process. Other attendees are free to talk and engage without worrying if their ideas are being documented, while you’re empowered to put your energy toward capturing key moments, challenges, questions, and action items. For agenda-led meetings, put your notes in the shared agenda. For other instances, you can capture in a collaborative document like Dropbox Paper and share after the meeting.

When you’re documenting real-time notes, write the speaker’s name before the note. Knowing who was speaking allows those reading your notes to gain context on the person — and in turn, their role and perspective. Go a step further by using smart formatting. Numbered lists are more citable than bulleted lists as they provide a specific number to refer back to, and indentations enable you to document a complete thread of conversation while avoiding run-on thoughts.

The quickest way to ensure you’re only documenting the most important takeaways (as opposed to a transcript) is to listen for questions, follow-up requests, and calls to action. If the situation calls for it, tag people and specify due dates. These are the most vital elements to refer back to, and it ensures that those who could not attend the meeting — or those who may be interested at a later time — have a clear view of what went unanswered and what comes next.
translations: 问任何一位运动员，他们都会告诉你：没有什么能替代更多的重复练习。通过主动提议在下次会议中担任记录员，你可以为这个过程注入专注。其他与会者可以自由交谈和参与，而不用担心他们的想法是否被记录下来，同时你也能够将精力集中在捕捉关键时刻、挑战、问题和行动项上。对于有议程引导的会议，将你的笔记放在共享议程中。对于其他情况，你可以在像 Dropbox Paper 这样的协作文档中记录，并在会后分享。
当你记录实时笔记时，在笔记前写下发言者的名字。让阅读你笔记的人了解发言者的背景——进而了解他们的角色和观点。更进一步，使用智能格式。编号列表比项目符号列表更易于引用，因为它们提供了特定的编号供回头参考，而缩进则使你能够记录完整的对话线程，同时避免思绪混乱。
确保只记录最重要的要点（而不是逐字记录）的最快方法是倾听问题、后续请求和行动号召。如果情况需要，可以标记人员并指定截止日期。这些是回头参考的最重要元素，它确保了未能参加会议的人——或者以后可能感兴趣的人——能够清楚地了解哪些问题没有得到解答，接下来会发生什么。

notes.phrase: put your energy toward capturing key moments
notes.meaning: 将精力投入到捕捉关键时刻上
notes.explain: 这个短语强调在会议记录时应该专注于记录最重要的内容，而不是试图记录所有内容
notes.example: During the brainstorming session, she put her energy toward capturing key moments rather than writing down every comment.

notes.phrase: notes, write the speaker’s name before
notes.meaning: 在笔记前写下发言者的名字
notes.explain: 这是一种会议记录技巧，通过标注发言者来增强笔记的上下文和可追溯性
notes.example: To keep track of different opinions, the secretary made sure to write the speaker's name before the note in the meeting minutes.

notes.phrase: listen for questions, follow-up requests, and calls to action
notes.meaning: 留意问题、后续请求和行动号召
notes.explain: 这是识别会议中最重要的可执行行动项的关键方法，这些内容通常需要后续跟进
notes.example: When taking minutes, the assistant focused on listening for questions, follow-up requests, and calls to action to ensure nothing was missed.

notes.phrase: tag people and specify due dates
notes.meaning: 标记人员并指定截止日期
notes.explain: 这是将会议记录转化为可执行行动项的具体操作，明确责任人和时间节点
notes.example: In the project update meeting, the project manager tagged people and specified due dates for each action item to ensure accountability.

scenario.title: Meeting Minutes Action Items
english: Alex is tasked with writing meeting minutes for the weekly team meeting, focusing on capturing key moments and action items.
The team manager emphasizes that minutes must include specific due dates and responsible persons, while some team members want more general notes to avoid micromanagement.
Alex clarifies by saying, 'Could you please confirm who will handle each action item and the deadline? This will help us track progress effectively.'
chinese: 亚历克斯负责撰写每周团队会议的会议记录，重点记录关键时刻和行动项。
团队经理强调记录必须包含具体的截止日期和负责人，而一些团队成员希望记录更笼统以避免微观管理。
亚历克斯澄清道：'能否请您确认每项行动项的负责人和截止日期？这将帮助我们有效跟踪进度。'

firstAttempt.prompt: 会议决定 Taylor 周四前测试新流程，Mei 周五前整理结果；但测试还在等 API 权限。请用英文写清决定、负责人和期限，并把尚未解决的问题单独列出。
firstAttempt.sample: Decision: Once API access is granted, Taylor will test the new workflow by Thursday. Action: Mei will share the results by Friday. Open question: Will API access arrive in time? The test is currently blocked by the access request.
firstAttempt.rationale: 会议记录要把决定、负责人、期限和未解决事项写到能直接跟进的程度。

words.example: To improve his presentation skills, he does reps in front of the mirror every morning.
words.translation: 为了提高他的演讲技巧，他每天早上都在镜子前进行练习。
words.note: repetitions 的口语缩写，常指训练或练习的重复次数。

words.example: A clear agenda helps the facilitator keep the discussion focused.
words.translation: 清晰的议程有助于主持人让讨论保持聚焦。
words.note: 表示为某个过程或活动增加清晰度和方向感

words.example: Please add the owner and due date to the collaborative document.
words.translation: 请在协作文档中补上负责人和截止时间。
words.note: 指允许多人同时编辑的在线文档，促进团队协作

words.example: Use simple formatting to make owners and due dates easy to scan.
words.translation: 用简单的格式突出负责人和截止时间，方便快速查看。
words.note: 指有意识地使用格式技巧（如编号、缩进等）来增强文档的可读性和可用性

words.example: The notes include the key takeaways and next steps.
words.translation: 会议记录写下了关键结论和下一步。
words.note: 指会议或讨论中最重要、需要记住的信息或结论

words.example: Turn each decision into a clear action item with an owner.
words.translation: 把每项决定转成有明确负责人的行动事项。
words.note: 指会议中明确要求参与者采取的具体行动或任务

structure.original: By proactively volunteering to lead notetaking in your next meeting, you inject focus into the process.
analysis: 介词短语'By proactively volunteering to lead notetaking in your next meeting'作为方式状语，修饰主句谓语动词'inject'，表示通过什么方式注入焦点
现在分词短语'proactively volunteering to lead notetaking'是介词'By'的宾语，其中'proactively'是副词修饰'volunteering'，'to lead notetaking'是不定式短语作'volunteering'的目的状语
主句'you inject focus into the process'中，'inject'是谓语动词，'focus'是宾语，'into the process'是介词短语作地点状语，表示注入焦点的对象或范围
structure.transfer: By actively participating in the discussion of your next project, you bring valuable insights into the decision-making process.

rewrite.bad: Please send me your meeting actions when you get a chance.
rewrite.good: Please add an owner, due date, and any blocker for each action item in the shared notes. I’ll label comments with the speaker’s name so we can follow up clearly.
rewrite.translation: 请在共享记录中为每项行动补上负责人、截止日期和阻碍。我会标注发言人，方便后续跟进。
rewrite.pattern: Please add [an owner, due date, and blocker] to each action, and label [who said what].

cloze.prompt: Decision: Taylor will test the new workflow once API access is ___. Owner: Taylor.
cloze.why: once API access is available 说明测试的前置条件。

cloze.prompt: Mei will share the results by ___.
cloze.why: by Friday 写明行动项的截止时间。

cloze.prompt: Open question: When will API access be ___?
cloze.why: 用 Open question 单独标出尚未确认的信息。

The team manager emphasizes that minutes must include specific due dates and responsible persons, while some team members want more general notes to avoid micromanagement.

choice.prompt: 会后你负责整理共享会议记录。请用英文请参会者补充行动项负责人、截止日期和当前阻碍，并在文档中标明发言者。
options: You need to tell me who does what and when for the meeting actions.
Please add an owner, due date, and any blocker for each action item in the shared notes. I’ll label comments with the speaker’s name so we can follow up clearly.
Please add an owner, due date, and any blocker for each action item in the shared notes.
choice.why: 行动记录要能支持后续执行；共享文档、负责人、日期和发言者信息让记录更容易跟进。

output.prompt: 会议决定保留旧版登录方式至月底，Jordan 周三前确认迁移影响，客服团队尚未确认是否需要更新帮助文章。请用英文整理决定、负责人和期限，并单列待解决问题。
output.sample: Decision: We’ll keep the current login option until the end of the month. Action: Jordan will confirm the migration impact by Wednesday. Open question: Does Support need to update the help article?
check: 是否记录了决定及负责人？
是否把未解决问题和当前阻碍单独写清？

taskPhrases.translation: 决定：API 权限开放后由 Taylor 测试新流程。负责人：Taylor。

taskPhrases.meaning: 为行动项写明完成期限

taskPhrases.example: Mei will share the results by Friday.
taskPhrases.translation: Mei 会在周五前分享结果。

taskPhrases.meaning: 把尚未解决的问题单独列出
